description: Java class implementing a fingerprint authentication dialog with fallback to password, handling enrollment, verification, and UI updates.

classes.name: FingerprintAuthenticationDialogFragment
classes.description: A dialog fragment for fingerprint authentication with password fallback, managing enrollment, verification, and UI states.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, sets style, and enrolls a user.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates layout, initializes UI components, sets click listeners, and updates UI stage.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Starts fingerprint listening if in fingerprint stage.

methods.name: setCryptoObject
methods.description: Sets the cryptographic object for fingerprint authentication.

methods.name: goToBackup
methods.description: Switches UI to password fallback stage.

methods.name: enroll
methods.description: Enrolls a user by retrieving public key from Android Keystore and registering with backend.

methods.name: verifyPassword
methods.description: Verifies entered password with backend, updates preferences, and proceeds if successful.

methods.name: updateStage
methods.description: Updates UI components based on current authentication stage.

methods.name: onEditorAction
methods.description: Handles IME action for password input.

methods.name: onAuthenticated
methods.description: Handles successful fingerprint authentication, signs transaction, and verifies with backend.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Handles fingerprint errors by switching to password fallback.
